source: instances/static-solvable/express-a2-login-401.json (patch reconstructed from gold_patch; original in neat-agent-bench/patches/A2.patch)
size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from where the symptom shows: the 401 'Incorrect email or password' is raised in the login service, but the faulty query is in getUserByEmail, a shared user-service helper that forgot-password also uses (one-line, one-file fix).
prompt: Login with correct credentials that just registered successfully always returns 401 'Incorrect email or password'.

root_cause.detail: getUserByEmail queries findOne({ emails: email }); the schema field is `email`. Mongoose 5.13 passes the unknown key through to MongoDB, so the lookup never matches: login throws 401 'Incorrect email or password' and forgot-password returns 404.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/login > should return 200 and login user if email and password match
tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/forgot-password > should return 204 and send reset password email to the user
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 200 and login user if email and password match|should return 204 and send reset password email to the user'
